svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class containing the collection of default coverage groups for MIPI DUAL DSI.
These groups are setup to use the default coverage data (packet transaction) provided by the svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage class and samples in response to the events triggered by the svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage class.
The list of covergroups defined in this class are:

  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_image_pkt_word_count
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_fsc_commands
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_overlap_pixels
  • svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_dummy_pixels.

svt_mipi_dsi_dual_fsc_commands covergroup definition.
  • Coverpoint svt_mipi_dsi_dual_fsc_commands: Declare bins to cover user defined FSC commands coming on all configured ports.
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_dual_fsc_commands;
   option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "Dual DSI Cover Group for User defined FSC commands coming on all configured ports";
   svt_mipi_dsi_dual_fsc_commands:coverpoint fsc_data_id
  {
    bins dcs_write0 = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::DCS_WRITE0};
    bins dcs_write1 = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::DCS_WRITE1};
    bins gen_write0 = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::GEN_WRITE0};
    bins gen_write1 = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::GEN_WRITE1};
    bins dcs_long_write = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::DCS_LONG_WRITE};
    bins gen_long_write = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::GEN_LONG_WRITE};
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports

svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports covergroup definition.
  • Coverpoint svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports: Declare bins to cover number of active ports which are configured using the DSI Dual configuration.
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports;
   option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "Dual DSI Cover Group for number of active ports";
   svt_mipi_dsi_dual_num_active_ports:coverpoint dsi_dual_cfg.num_active_ports {
    bins num_ports1 = {1};
    bins num_ports2 = {2};
    bins num_ports3 = {3};
    ignore_bins num_ports_1 = {2,3} iff(dsi_dual_cfg.num_active_ports == 1);
    ignore_bins num_ports_2 = {1,3} iff(dsi_dual_cfg.num_active_ports == 2);
    ignore_bins num_ports_3 = {1,2} iff(dsi_dual_cfg.num_active_ports == 3);
  }
 endgroup
